column1: # Reviewed owner of every skill bundled by the pinned `libraries/agent-plugins` marketplace.
# This file is the AUTHORIZATION source for "who owns this bundled skill", and it lives here — in
# the consumer, under review — rather than inside the skills, because the only other record is the
# skill's own `metadata.github-repo`: a field written by whoever authors the skill upstream and
# copied verbatim by the updater. Read on its own, that field lets a third-party release declare a
# `devantler-tech` URL and grant itself the exemptions this deployment reserves for suite-owned
# skills. A reviewed row is what an upstream cannot write.
# The self-attested field may only WITHDRAW: `skill-owner.sh --check-reviewed` compares it against
# the row and reports MISMATCH when the two disagree, and that check fails. A bundled skill with no
# row is UNLISTED, which also fails the check, so a newly bundled skill surfaces at the gitlink bump
# instead of silently defaulting — and until a row is reviewed in, it is treated as third-party. A
# row naming a skill the bundle no longer carries is STALE and fails the check too, so the file
# cannot outlive the bundle it describes.
# Format: <plugin>\t<skill>\t<upstream repository that owns its content>
# Lines beginning with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
